_comment: Source of truth for tools/build.py (metadata, levels, conversion options). Mutopia entries name the ftp directory fetched by fetch_mutopia.py; 'own' entries are generated by arrange.py. Levels: 1 five-finger position, 2 easy (ABRSM ~1-2), 3 early intermediate (~2-4), 4 intermediate (~5-6), 5 stretch (~6-7). tempoBpm is in quarter notes per minute, the same unit as MusicXML <sound tempo>.

pieces.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
pieces.notes: Right hand in C position (the A is a small stretch of the 5th finger); left hand plays whole-note and half-note C-position chords.

pieces.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
pieces.notes: Right hand stays in C position (C-G); left hand holds C and G notes.

pieces.title: Ode to Joy (simplified)
pieces.notes: Theme simplified to stay in C position for the right hand; left hand plays open fifths and single notes.

pieces.title: Frère Jacques
pieces.notes: Melody in the right hand around C position (the A4 in bars 5-6 and the low G3 of the closing ding-dang-dong need small extensions); left hand alternates C and G.

pieces.title: Jingle Bells (chorus)
pieces.notes: Chorus only. Right hand in C position; left hand plays C, F and G7 harmonies as held notes.

pieces.title: Happy Birthday to You
pieces.composer: Mildred J. Hill and Patty Hill
pieces.notes: In the public domain in the United States since the 2016 settlement of Marya v. Warner/Chappell (the court found no valid copyright in the lyrics, 2015); in the EU the song entered the public domain on 1 January 2017. Melody spans an octave, so it needs one hand shift.

pieces.title: Amazing Grace
pieces.notes: Melody in F major over a simple bass with held chords.

pieces.title: Scarborough Fair
pieces.notes: Traditional Dorian melody with an open-fifth accompaniment; deliberately avoids the copyrighted 1966 Simon & Garfunkel arrangement and its 'Canticle' counter-melody.

pieces.title: Greensleeves
pieces.notes: Melody in A minor (6/8) over dotted-half bass notes and simple chords.

pieces.title: Canon in D (simplified)
pieces.notes: Easy arrangement in augmentation (half notes, as in most easy editions): the left hand plays the famous eight-note ground bass, the right hand the first two lines of the first violin, which move in 3rds and 5ths against the bass.

pieces.title: Minuet in G major
pieces.notes: From the 1725 Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach; long attributed to J. S. Bach, now to Christian Petzold. Engraved from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition.

pieces.title: Minuet in G minor
pieces.notes: Companion piece to BWV Anh. 114 in the 1725 Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach; attributed to Christian Petzold. Engraved from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition.

pieces.title: Minuet in F major
pieces.notes: Written down in January 1762, when Mozart was six. Engraved from the Breitkopf & Härtel Alte Mozart-Ausgabe.

pieces.title: Melody (Album for the Young, No. 1)
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Mélodie'. Engraved from the Peters edition. The engraving is CC BY-SA 2.5 (attribution: Philippe Hézaine / Mutopia Project); this MusicXML is shared under the same license.

pieces.title: La Candeur (Frankness)
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Collection Litolff edition, including its fingerings.

pieces.title: Arabesque
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Collection Litolff edition, including its fingerings.

pieces.title: Pastorale
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Collection Litolff edition, including its fingerings.

pieces.title: Innocence
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Collection Litolff edition, including its fingerings.

pieces.title: The Wild Rider (Album for the Young, No. 8)
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Le cavalier sauvage'. Engraved from the Peters edition. The engraving is CC BY-SA 2.5 (attribution: Philippe Hézaine / Mutopia Project); this MusicXML is shared under the same license. The repeat ends mid-bar (pickup structure), so that bar is split into two MusicXML measures (8 and 8a).

pieces.title: Sonatina in C major, 1st movement (Spiritoso)
pieces.notes: First movement only (the Mutopia file contains all three). Engraved from the G. Schirmer Sonatina Album (1893), which marks it Spiritoso (often printed as Allegro).

pieces.title: Prelude in C major (Well-Tempered Clavier, Book I, No. 1)
pieces.notes: Written as three voices (the held bass and tenor notes are separate voices), as in the Mutopia engraving.

pieces.title: Gymnopédie No. 1
pieces.notes: Published 1888, public domain worldwide (Satie died in 1925). Engraved from a Dover reprint. Key signature of D major with modal harmony (alternating G major 7th and D major 7th chords); the piece ends on a D minor chord.

pieces.title: Für Elise (Bagatelle in A minor)
pieces.notes: Complete piece. Engraved from the Breitkopf & Härtel edition (1888). The 1st-ending bar is a partial bar, as printed.

pieces.title: Piano Sonata in C major ('Sonata facile'), 1st movement (Allegro)
pieces.notes: Complete first movement. The engraving is CC BY-SA 3.0 (attribution: Alejandro Sierra / Mutopia Project); this MusicXML is shared under the same license. Editorial fingerings are kept in the .fingered copy.

pieces.title: Prelude in A major
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Peters edition. Default tempo 72 rather than the 120 of the Mutopia MIDI, which is too fast for Andantino. The source has a single editorial fingering, so no .fingered copy is provided.

pieces.title: Prelude in E minor
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Peters edition (1879).

pieces.title: Invention No. 1 in C major
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition. The engraving is CC BY-SA 3.0 (attribution: Jeff Covey / Mutopia Project); this MusicXML is shared under the same license.

pieces.title: The Entertainer
pieces.notes: Complete rag, engraved from a reproduction of the original 1902 edition (public domain: published 1902). 'Not fast', as Joplin marked it.

pieces.title: Piano Sonata No. 14 'Moonlight', 1st movement (opening)
pieces.excerpt: Bars 1-27 of 69: introduction and exposition (the development starts at bar 28).
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Berners edition (1908, ed. A. Winterberger), including its fingerings. The engraving is CC BY-SA 2.5 (attribution: Stewart Holmes / Mutopia Project); this MusicXML is shared under the same license. LilyPond 2.10 auto-beam commands were replaced by their 2.24 equivalent (triplets beamed per quarter-note beat) before conversion.

pieces.title: Waltz in B minor (opening)
pieces.excerpt: Pickup and bars 1-32 of 146: the main waltz theme (A section), ending on the tonic; the last bar keeps its run-up to the B section.
pieces.notes: Engraved from the Peters edition (ed. Herrmann Scholtz), including its fingerings. Moderato, quarter = 152 as printed in that edition.
